text: The owned follow-up moves window opening/title checks into add_setup and awaits a250ms timer afterward. Accepted source retains the timer after msgLoaded and title checks, with a one-statement lint exception and a comment that the changing state is still unclear. The earlier50/100ms report is historical; it does not identify a required state transition or prove this delay cures the race. Preserve this exception without treating arbitrary delays as a general readiness pattern. No timer or keyboard test ran.
title: The message-window setup delay remains an unresolved local workaround
